capabilities: hunt animated bugs that appear as you write or finish tasks
steal display-only letters and leave footprints without editing notes
nap on code blocks and callouts and sleep when you are away
play with graph view nodes and react to pointer, searches and dragged tabs
configure size, color, temperament, bugs, mischief and reduced motion
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; it requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or newer and works on desktop and mobile.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to add a playful ambient companion that reacts to activity in the workspace.
summary: Animated pixel gecko companion that wanders your workspace, reacts to your typing, searches and graph, and never alters your notes.
